description:
The plan, the permissions this API key holds, and quota remaining. Call this first if a later call fails with a payment or permission error — it says exactly what the key can and cannot do.

The `endpoints` block lists every endpoint split into what this key can call and what it cannot, with the missing scope named per entry. Read it instead of discovering the boundary by being refused: a key without posts:publish can prepare and schedule everything and publish nothing, and saying so up front is better than failing the call.
name: planify_me
title: Planify: account and plan
